name: domain-password-pattern-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): plants the shared weak password pattern 'Name!AcmeNNNN' across several REAL accounts (the source competition leaked the whole domain pattern from three logons where the password was typed into the username field). Vars: ACCOUNTS (required, csv of samaccountname:password entries, e.g. 'daffy.duck:Daffy!Acme4103,...'); PATTERN (optional regex; every planted password is validated against it and any mismatch throws -- detect build-time mistakes early). Creates accounts that do not exist (enabled, PasswordNeverExpires) and resets/rotates existing ones. Idempotent. Pairs with a powershell_json check: no enabled AD account has a password matching PATTERN (the named accounts' passwords are rotated off it); the forensics answer needs exactly ONE account per concrete password -- keep the three accounts distinct.
